scope: M9A compression, simply supported, m=1, uniform reference stress
production_decision: Only the unconstrained FSM eigensolver is design-path eligible. No pyCUFSM constrained cFSM result is authoritative.

constrained_cfsm_orth_1.reference: Official MATLAB CUFSM v5.66 with the identical configuration

constrained_cfsm_orth_2.public_api_failure: TypeError: Argument 'm_a' has incorrect type (expected numpy.ndarray, got list)
constrained_cfsm_orth_2.disposition: No patch, monkey-patch, alternate backend, or substituted orthogonality configuration is permitted. orth=1 evidence is not generalized to orth=2.

translated_source_defects.defect: The modal-orthogonalization path passes m_a=[m_i] to a compiled API requiring numpy.ndarray.
translated_source_defects.effect: Blocks the public constrained cFSM orth=2 execution before LOCAL, DISTORTIONAL, or GLOBAL results exist.

translated_source_defects.defect: The second element-direction reversal tests the element number instead of its direction flag.
translated_source_defects.effect: Changes GLOBAL/DISTORTIONAL constraint vectors for affected contour orientations.

translated_source_defects.defect: Edge-node adjacency is reduced to a Boolean before nonzero indexing.
translated_source_defects.effect: Can select element zero instead of the actual adjacent element in the natural local/other basis.

translated_source_defects.defect: Already zero-based node numbers are decremented again in other-mode assembly.
translated_source_defects.effect: Wraps node zero to a negative index and invalidates OTHER-space vectors.

translated_source_defects.defect: The full numpy.linalg.lstsq return tuple and floating-point DOF indexes are used as though they were MATLAB coefficient arrays and integer indexes.
translated_source_defects.effect: The translated automatic modal-classification routine is not executable/reliable.
